evals.name: github-pr-ios-android
evals.expected_output: Detects GitHub from the remote, names PR #42 (https://github.com/acme/aqx-mobile/pull/42) and says it will post with gh pr comment. Writes the block to the scratchpad: first line VERIFIED 2 of 4; iOS and Android sections, no Web; TC-3 android listed as not run; TC-4 (removed) left out; TC-1 iOS shots in a 3-per-row table with the last row padded and captions from the file names; TC-2 'What I saw' copied; one server check line, no token. Every file has a placeholder. Lists the files with sizes and waits for a yes. Nothing uploaded or posted.
assertions: Repo unchanged and nothing written into .evidence
Every screenshot and video has a placeholder
No token or header from server.txt in the block
Names GitHub and the PR link
Plans to post with gh pr comment
iOS and Android sections, no Web section
TC-3 android listed as not run
Screenshot rows have 3 cells each (last row padded)
Captions come from the file names
Server check line under TC-1 iOS

evals.name: gitlab-selfhosted-mr
evals.expected_output: Detects GitLab from the self-hosted remote gitlab.acme.dev, says MR !17 (https://gitlab.acme.dev/mobile/aqx/-/merge_requests/17) and says it will post with glab. Finds the evidence under .evidence/sentence-search/ (generic file name, so the folder name is the key). Block: VERIFIED 2 of 2; Web and iOS sections, no Android; SS2 (inactive) left out. Waits for a yes. Nothing uploaded or posted, no gh used.
assertions: Repo unchanged and nothing written into .evidence
Every screenshot and video has a placeholder
Names GitLab and the MR link
Web and iOS sections, no Android section

evals.name: bitbucket-other-host

Block: VERIFIED 2 of 4; Web and iOS sections; TC-2 fail with 'What I saw' copied; TC-4 ios listed as not run. Waits for a yes. Nothing uploaded or posted.
assertions: Repo unchanged and nothing written into .evidence
Every screenshot and video has a placeholder
Uses the given Bitbucket PR link
Says the user presses Comment (no gh or glab post)
TC-4 ios listed as not run
